description: Ministry of Transport & Civil Aviation - Amendment to the Motor Traffic Fees Regulations 2013, published in the Gaz. Ex. No. 1776/22 of 08.02.2013
reasoning: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister of Transport and Civil Aviation under the Motor Traffic Act, amending previous regulations related to vehicle registration fees, delay charges, and vehicle categories. The content focuses on legal/regulatory matters - specifically the amendment of existing regulations and the establishment of new regulatory requirements. While a minister is named, this is incidental to the primary purpose of publishing new legal regulations, making it a Legal/Regulatory Gazette rather than a government personnel or hybrid classification.
